tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
EMD shall be furnished as prescribed in the Tender Document. Tender Processing fee paid is not refundable by the Department.
Prices shall be quoted all inclusive of taxes at e-portal.

Any addendum/corrigendum which may issue by the Department will not be published in newspapers. Hence Tenderers shall initially confirm for any such amendments either through e-portal or with the department via communication before submitting the bid.
All documents related to Technical and commercial issues shall be furnished as per the Tender Conditions. Hence Tender document shall be referred for such documentation submission.
Tenderers are advised to contact Department for any clarifications before closing of the Tender.
All relevant documents shall be furnished as per the Tender Document.
All Other Terms and Conditions are applicable as per the Tender Document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Participating tenderer shall comply with all the necessary requirements as per section-vii & viii and shall produce relevant documents to this effect.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Participating tenderer shall comply with all the necessary requirements as per section-vii & viii and shall produce relevant documents to this effect.
Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A declaration stating that all labour laws are followed and no child labour is engaged in their organization
Acknowledgment for having submitted the samples of all kinds of paper as mentioned in Schedule of Section-VI of the tender document
Acknowledgment of IT returns filed for the preceding two assessment years 2025-26 & 2026-27. proper justification shall be submitted if the returns for the year 2026-27 is still due for filing

Annual GST returns filed for the previous financial years 2024-25 and 2025-26. If annual returns for the year 2025-26 has not been filed, returns of each month or quarterly returns from April, 2025 to March, 2026 shall be uploaded.
Latest GST returns filed for the month of August, 2026 or September, 2026.
List of plant & machinery, working strength, as per Section XIV
Past two years experience as per Section XIII Work orders and/or Satisfactory completion reports shall be uploaded
